title: GAM-clustering analysis of spatial RNA-seq data
text: First, load initialize objects required GAM-clustering analysis: load metabolic network metabolites annotation. provide two networks: KEGG combined network includes KEGG, Rhea transport reactions: (1.1.) load KEGG metabolic network network.kegg.rds metabolites annotation met.kegg.db.rds (1.2.) load combined metabolic network network.combined.rds, metabolites annotation met.combined.db.rds species-specific list genes either come proteome linked specific enzyme gene2reaction.combined.mmu.eg.tsv mouse gene2reaction.combined.hsa.eg.tsv human data; load species-specific network annotation: org.Hs.eg.gatom.anno human data org.Mm.eg.gatom.anno mouse data; load provided list metabolites considered analysis connections reactions (e.g., CO2, HCO3-, etc); initialize MWCS solver: (4.1.) recommend use either heuristic relax--cut solver rnc_solver mwcsr package, (4.2.) either proprietary CPLEX solver (free academy); set working directory results saved . TEMPORARY: collecting logs developing tool.
